content.title: Repeated Reset | Small Mishaps Escalate Across Multiple Scenes
content.summary: Repeatedly perform normal preparations, active actions, visible consequences, witness reactions, and scene resets for the same character relationship; changing physical issues and increasing consequence intensity each round.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed role relationship + three rounds of preparation/action/consequence/reaction + scene reset + consequence upgrade round by round + maximum result in the same frame
quick_start.recommended_input: The first scene of the original freeze-frame workshop, the copper apprentice robot pulls the loose spring, and the washers spread out in front of the same green supervision light; the magnetic brush pulls the paint beads into an enlarged trajectory, and the green light clearly tilts back, with greater consequences than the first scene; the copper robot, the tilted green light and the largest gear field are stopped in the same frame, without adding dialogue or repair results
required_anchors: Keep the same active-role and witness relationship readable across every reset.
Establish an ordinary object and action before each mishap.
Increase consequence scale or spatial reach across rounds.
Hold both roles and the largest consequence together.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Repeatedly perform normal preparations, active actions, visible consequences, witness reactions, and scene resets for the same character relationship; changing physical issues and increasing consequence intensity each round.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Repeat a compact vignette grammar across different spaces: ordinary setup, one autonomous action by the same active role, one visible material consequence, one reaction by the recurring witness, then a clean reset. Change the physical problem each round and increase consequence scale before a held final reaction.

invariants.rule: Keep the same active-role and witness relationship readable across every reset.
invariants.purpose: Makes separate rooms feel like one anthology.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing both roles turns the sequence into unrelated clips.

invariants.rule: Establish an ordinary object and action before each mishap.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on a mess removes responsibility and timing.

invariants.rule: Use a different material consequence in each round.
invariants.purpose: Creates variation rather than duplicate gags.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating one mishap adds no proof.

invariants.rule: Increase consequence scale or spatial reach across rounds.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random intensity without a ladder feels arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Hold both roles and the largest consequence together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting before the reaction loses the payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source food, furniture or domestic props
the exact mishap order and reactions
the source wardrobe and family identity
